pages.taming: When charged, feed a bucket of skib, then a $(treat2); repeat this process several times

pages.text: Murks consume skibs to harness their volatile red energy

Murks enter a charged state after roaring when aggravated. In this state, a murk's attacks deal extra damage and inflict the $(c)Volatile$() effect, which deals explosive damage to the afflicted at the end of the effect.$(br2)Murks can be ridden when tamed. While riding, Press $(ability) to enter the charged state when the HUD meter is full. Doing so with an incomplete bar or whilst it is charged will make the Murk shoot its projectile breath instead.
